notes.title: Funtime with Buffy
notes.notes: Things are not going so well since you've been left alone in the house. Your friendly plushie toy, Buffy, is not so friendly anymore. Otherwise he's haunting you all along.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
-fixed a bug where you get stuck in the treehouse
-no more jumpscares while Buffy is on the couch (unless you get too close)
-Improved AI
-Buffy no longer gets stuck
-fixed a bug where Buffy teleports too close randomly and unusual
-tearing screen fixed
-added a smoke effect for everytime he spawns and despawns - POOF! like a magician
